name: lying prone y raise
description: Lying face down, you lift your arms into a Y shape to strengthen the muscles that stabilise your shoulder blades.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms stretched overhead in a Y shape.
Keep your forehead near the floor and your neck long.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower your arms slowly and repeat.
